intro.title: Resin, Fibre and Clay Idols
intro.descriptionHtml: Choose from the widest range and variety of idols of Gods and Goddesses to adorn your office desktop, car dashboard, study table or Puja altar. These beautiful idols are made of metal, bonded marble, plaster of paris, China clay and other materials. They are small in size and so can easily fit in bag and can be carried during travel.
